_comment: Analysis config: datasets -> pipeline steps (artefacts) -> figures. Run: python -m optidaq.analysis.pipeline --config configs/analysis_v1.json

cameras._comment: beam: camera of the screen image. fibre: label -> camera, one fibre or several.

datasets._comment: One block per dataset under a name of your choice. Keys other than adapter, path and preprocess are options of the adapter (optidaq_db: sync_guard_ns, where, otsu).

pipeline._comment: One block per step; module selects the code, the block name is the artefact folder. The same module can run under several names with different parameters.

spots._comment: select: "all", or grid with n cells along the longer image side. reach_px: null takes the grid cell size; with "all" give a number.

samples._comment: Frames whose images are saved for figures: listed sample ids, plus the frames at these quantiles of the fibre error.

style._comment: Look shared by all figures; a figure block can override it in its own style key. rc takes any matplotlib rcParams.

figures._comment: One block per figure; figure selects the code, source names the pipeline step whose artefacts are drawn.
